scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cello! This browser writes every page from scratch, with no network calls. Here's how.

scenes.text: At about 1,850 tokens a second, a model writes a whole page's HTML while the browser paints it, so generating feels like loading.
scenes.say: The idea: at about eighteen hundred and fifty tokens a second, writing a page starts to feel like loading one.

steps.say: A GPU holds about two hundred megabytes on chip, so every weight streams in from HBM for every token.
It gets fast by batching many users. One lone request stays slow.
Cerebras keeps the whole model in forty-four gigabytes of SRAM, beside nine hundred thousand cores.
Nothing to amortize, so a single request runs near its peak.
